item.title: Slash Commands 1.0.1
item.description:
## What's New in 1.0.1
### Command Editing - Added Markdown previews for saved command bodies, including headings, lists, code blocks, quotes, links, and checklists. - Added a raw source copy button so you can copy the exact saved Markdown body from preview mode. - Added command body history so you can restore earlier saved versions while editing.
### Settings - Changed app targeting to a blocklist model so commands stay available in eligible apps unless you choose to block them. - Improved the setup flow with clearer permission recovery steps when macOS access needs attention.
### Reliability - Fixed cases where command expansion could stall after secure input, app focus, or accessibility lookup failures. - Improved command body preview safety so image-style Markdown appears as text instead of loading remote images.
